title: STING reprogramming by estrogen promotes neutrophil extracellular trap formation and sex-biased resistance to ADC therapy
title_zh: 雌激素通过STING重编程促进中性粒细胞胞外网格形成及性别差异的ADC治疗耐受性
abstract: Sex differences in cancer therapy response remain poorly understood. Using a "phase II-like preclinical trial" across 55 CLDN18.2+ pancreatic cancer patient-derived xenografts, we identify marked female-biased resistance to CLDN18.2-targeted antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) therapy despite equivalent antigen expression. Mechanistically, estrogen signals through GPER1 to upregulate TRAF6, redirecting tumor-intrinsic STING signaling from IRF3-mediated interferon production toward nuclear factor κB (NF-κB) activation. This drives CXCL1 secretion, neutrophil recruitment, and neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) formation. NETs form a charged extracellular network that restricts antibody access to tumor-cell-surface antigens-a mechanism we term functional antigen shielding-reducing ADC cytotoxicity independently of antigen expression. The NET burden also correlated with poorer responses to trastuzumab, cetuximab, and enfortumab vedotin across three clinical cohorts. Pharmacologic NET disruption with sivelestat restored ADC efficacy in female mice. These findings reveal an estrogen-driven resistance mechanism with broad implications for antibody-based cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 关于癌症治疗中性别差异的机制尚不清楚。我们在55例CLDN18.2+胰腺癌患者来源的异种移植模型中进行“类似二期临床前试验”，发现尽管抗原表达相同，女性对CLDN18.2靶向抗体药物偶联物（ADC）治疗表现出明显的耐受性。机制上，雌激素通过GPER1信号通路上调TRAF6，重新引导肿瘤内在的STING信号从IRF3介导的干扰素产生转向核因子κB（NF‑κB）激活。此过程驱动CXCL1分泌、中性粒细胞募集以及中性粒细胞胞外网格（NET）形成。NET形成带电的胞外网络，限制抗体对肿瘤细胞表面抗原的接触——我们称之为功能性抗原遮蔽——从而在不依赖抗原表达的情况下降低ADC的细胞毒性。NET负荷与三组临床队列中曲妥珠单抗、赛妥昔单抗和恩福妥单抗的疗效差异相关。使用西维乐特（sivelestat）药理学破坏NET后，恢复了雌性小鼠对ADC的疗效。这些发现揭示了一种雌激素驱动的耐受机制，对抗体基因癌症治疗具有广泛意义。
